tldr: The Moon in Capricorn: emotions seek structure, responsibility, and earned security.
body: With the Moon in Capricorn, feelings are serious, contained, and often managed through competence. The Moon is in detriment here, so softness may need deliberate permission before it feels safe.
gift: Emotional discipline, reliability, maturity, and the ability to stay steady under pressure.
challenge: Coldness, self-denial, and measuring emotional worth by productivity or control.
note: Authored from approved project planet-through-sign material.
